answer: Peer-audit bond: each identity locks 70 credits, files a voyage log on the mesa, and is checked by three random peers staking 10 each; peers re-run the work at a summit review each epoch. Copied logs, stale work, or two peers sharing one key burns bond and stakes. First audit 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented peers fail: distinct keys, prior work required. An honest identity pays 40 once, keeps its share.
